## Highlights

- Added Smart Text overflow modes for overlay title, artist, and album fields
- Expanded SIP v1 integration with browser-support discovery and toggling
- Hardened settings saves so invalid or unavailable overlay ports do not replace the last working configuration
- Improved release packaging, installer naming, signing support, and SIP smoke validation

## Overlay improvements

- Added per-field Smart Text modes for clipping, horizontal scrolling, two-line wrapping, and automatic font sizing
- Kept character limits as the first overflow guard so existing compact overlay profiles stay predictable
- Updated overlay previews and generated overlay HTML so Smart Text behavior matches OBS/browser-source output
- Preserved richer TIDAL artist credits from window-title metadata when media sessions expose a shorter artist value for the same track

## SIP and integration

- Added SIP browser-support capability reporting and `GET` / `POST /api/v1/browser-support`
- Added browser source state to SIP status so integrations can distinguish desktop, browser, and idle playback sources
- Added a SIP Newman smoke collection and release-workflow gate for the local integration contract
- Updated the SIP API reference and Postman collections for the current SIP v1 payloads and validation rules

## Reliability and settings safety

- Rejected invalid overlay ports outside `1-65535` during user-initiated saves
- Verified overlay listener startup before persisting settings, so occupied or invalid ports leave the previous settings active
- Added frontend validation for poll interval, overlay port, browser source cooldown, and stale-session timeout
- Added visible UI feedback for backend polling failures and common settings actions such as refresh, folder selection, release-page opening, and overlay URL copying
- Added confirmation prompts before discarding unsaved settings or switching overlay profiles with unsaved edits

## Release and packaging

- Fixed the packaged desktop executable name to `TideReader.exe`
- Added Authenticode signing support to local and GitHub release packaging
- Added release-workflow SIP smoke checks before packaging artifacts
- Kept installer defaults aligned with the Starsong Installer Standard

## Security posture

- SIP remains loopback-only and continues to reject non-localhost `Host` headers
- Mutating SIP requests still require JSON, reject unknown fields, and enforce the request-body size limit
- Frontend error feedback is rendered as text and does not expose local API tokens
- Settings validation now prevents invalid or failed overlay listener configurations from being persisted

## Notes

- This release is a minor version bump because it adds user-facing Smart Text overlay behavior and expands the SIP integration surface
- Automated frontend coverage, backend coverage, dependency audit, release build, SIP smoke, and vulnerability checks passed during release preparation
